title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I heard from someone that nikah can not happen(not valid) if a woman is in state of menses...is it true? 3489 views Q. I heard a brief of hadith which says that offspring of the couple married within close relatives often prove to be weaker or having genetic disorders. And the wordings of hadith quoted by my Aalim friend were as follows "Innal walada la-ahwal...." however he couldn't find the complete hadith and it's source. Can you please affirm this hadith, it's correctness and the source with proper tradition. This might be from Mishkat Al-Masabih. 2562 views Q. Now We want arrange his nIkah with cousin( MOther's sister Daughter). We want ask to you. can he do nikah with cousin or not? Your highly appriciated suggestion will needful for we. 2316 views Q. My younger Nephew & Niece are young and on the age of marriage, my family has seen some boys in other family location 30 K.Ms away one is doing job and other is student. One boy is my Mama's son (cousion) and other is my Cousion son. Now both of them has refused to say yes or no for marriage. But learnt that one who is doing job has engaged with some other one. My question is that either we have continue our family terms or we cut off the family terms or wait till the 2nd relative may give us any answer. Thanks 1568 views Q. If a man has practiced mutually willed adultry with a woman, will it be permissible for him to marry her? i asked this question to two Ullemas but i got contrast verdicts, so i request you to explain whatever verdict is authentic. I also heard that compunsation of fornication to an unmarried person is to get wipped 80 times. so i need to ask if the person needs to get this punishment, whom does he confess to as there is no implemented islamic sharia law anywhere. please help me out with my questions. i will wait for your reply. 3858 views Q. What says Uluma-e-Karam in the light of Quran-o-Sunnah: There is a practice in our area according to which Nikah is done in proper Islamic way at the time of engagement but at the time of rukhsati, again Nikah is done in the same way. Uluma doing so admit the fact that once Nikah is done at the time of engagement, it is not necessary to repeat it at the time of rukhsati however they says it is better to repeat it ( or renew it ) at the time of rukhsati. It is necessary to mention here that it is an integaral part of the marriage ceremony in our area to arrange a function of doing nikah on the evening of Shabe-uroosi in which all close relatives participate. So if this function is not done, there would be confusion in the mind of relatives. My question is: ? whether this practice of repeating nikah is according to Quran-o-Sunnah and is there any evidence available in Sunnah. ? Is there any Hadees proving that this practice is forbidden. ? Then in case there is no evidence available in Sunah regarding allowing or disallowing, whether one can be allowed to repeat nikah for the sake of making people?s mind clear. 3766 views Q. I am getting married next month on 4 Feb 2012, my intention is to follow the Sunnah way but my mother-in-law during the day of nikah wants to invite all the known people 2274 views
answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 7026 Country: India Title: Should marriages be celebrated with great pomp and show or not? 2)can brother and sister roam together? Question: assalamualaikum. Should marriages be celebrated with great pomp and show or not? 2)can brother and sister roam together? Answer ID: 7026 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1785/1382=H/1429) If you do not remember whether you did it with or without lust, then there will be no ruling of hurmat in the matter mentioned above. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
